headline: ISD evaluation finds accuracy and completeness gaps in election answers, with a marked Spanish-language decline
summary: The Institute for Strategic Dialogue (ISD) published a structured evaluation of six chatbot models answering US election-procedure questions across ten selected states. Its mid-2026 dataset contains 2,400 responses to generic and adversarial prompts. ISD reports that 29% of generic English answers were incomplete, inaccurate or outdated, while another 16% were correct but omitted important voter details; it reports a 16% overall accuracy decline for generic Spanish prompts. These are report-reported findings from a single response per test condition, with material API/UI and state-selection limits—not estimates of current nationwide product performance.
